qualification: Candidates must have passed the 10th class examination or its equivalent (under the 10+2 system) with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks from a recognised board, and must also possess a National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the notified trade issued by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT).

age_limit: Candidates should have completed 15 years of age and should not have completed 24 years of age as on 05.09.2026. || Candidates claiming reservation benefits must produce the relevant caste, non-creamy layer, disability, or discharge certificate, as applicable, issued by the appropriate authority at the time of document verification. || To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.
application_fee: The fee is payable only through the online payment gateway (debit card, credit card, internet banking, SBI challan, etc.) integrated with the application form; cash, cheque, money order, or demand draft are not accepted. Payment must be completed within 2 working days of successfully filling the application, and no edits are allowed once the fee is paid. selection_process: Selection is based on a merit list, without any written examination or interview, prepared as follows: || The merit list is based on the simple average of the percentage of marks in matriculation (minimum 50% aggregate) and the percentage of marks in the ITI/NTC certificate for the relevant trade. || Matriculation percentage is calculated using marks obtained in all subjects, not just a selected group of subjects. || In case of a tie in marks, the older candidate is preferred; if the date of birth is also the same, the candidate who passed matriculation earlier is preferred. || A final merit list is prepared trade-wise and community-wise, in descending order of marks, equal to the number of available seats. || Shortlisted candidates are called for Document Verification, where original certificates and a medical fitness certificate are checked. Call letters for document verification may be issued to up to 1.5 times the number of identified slots. || Selected candidates must also be found medically fit as per the standards prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961 and the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992.
